g.text: Multi-region with RDBMS on Amazon EKS
Three EKS clusters, one Orchestration Cluster, one Aurora Global Database.
Compute spans three regions; the database spans two.
COMPUTE one EKS cluster and one Camunda zone per region
With the AWS VPC CNI a pod address is an ordinary VPC address, so no overlay is needed.
L3 AWS Transit Gateway, one hub per region
peering is not transitive: one edge per region pair
publishes each region's Zeebe service under one clusterset name
One namespace name in every cluster: the cluster ID prefix disambiguates.
SECONDARY STORAGE Aurora Global Database, reached over the Transit Gateway
replication and writer failover are the database's job
The same URL in every region. The driver follows the writer across a global failover.
